const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Recorded control script for the door task (instance 00).
+
+The episode is controlled through the rcb_client service.  This file is kept
+as the durable record of the observations and actions used in the run.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver
+
+OUT = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
+os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
+
+
+def save_json(name, value):
+    path = os.path.join(OUT, name)
+    with open(path, "w") as f:
+        json.dump(value, f, indent=2, default=lambda x: x.tolist() if hasattr(x, "tolist") else str(x))
+    return path
+
+
+def connect():
+    robot = Robot()
+    save_json("spec.json", robot.spec())
+    return robot
+
+
+def save_result(res, name):
+    directory = os.path.join(OUT, name)
+    os.makedirs(directory, exist_ok=True)
+    res.save(directory)
+    save_json(os.path.join(name, "meta.json"), res.meta)
+    return directory
+
+
+def status(robot):
+    value = robot.status()
+    save_json("status.json", value)
+    return value
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    r = connect()
+    print(json.dumps(status(r), indent=2))
+    obs = r.get_obs(video="frames")
+    save_result(obs, "initial")
+    print("saved initial observation", obs.meta)
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
